title: Constructible completion assembled in the native total-tensor presentation
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $W$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], and use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and completed coefficient sheaf $B=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_W$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. For $M,N\in D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], let $M\otimes^L_BN$ be the ordinary ambient derived tensor product, computed by the total tensor of flat-term K-flat representatives [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and let $M\widehat\otimes^L_RN$ be the completed tensor product [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Then $M\otimes^L_BN$ is derived complete [def-weil-derived-complete], and the canonical comparison
$$
\chi_{M,N}:M\otimes^L_BN\longrightarrow M\widehat\otimes^L_RN
$$
is an isomorphism, natural in $M,N$. Here $\chi$ is the canonical map from the ordinary tensor complex to the product mapping-fiber complex of its reduction tower: on flat-term K-flat representatives $P\to M$, $Q\to N$ its level-$n$ map is the coefficient quotient map
$$
\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_BQ)\longrightarrow
\operatorname{Res}_n\operatorname{Tot}\bigl((P\otimes_B(A_n)_W)\otimes_{(A_n)_W}(Q\otimes_B(A_n)_W)\bigr),
$$
with the strict quotient transitions, and the completed tensor on the right is the derived limit of this tower. The signed total tensor and its homogeneous generator are the existing native coefficientTotalTensor and coefficientTensorGenerator APIs [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion-presentation]; the boundary is the actual 1-s map of the strict tensor tower.

lean.statement:
theorem constructibleTensorCompletionNative [CompactSpace W] [QuasiSeparatedSpace W]
    [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)] :
    ∃ (T : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E W) ×
        DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E W) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E W))
      (e : ((integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).ι.prod
          (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).ι) ⋙ totalTensor l E W ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Q ≅
        ((integralOperationsGoodLocalization l E W).prod
          (integralOperationsGoodLocalization l E W)) ⋙ T)
      (chi : totalTensor l E W ⟶ integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l E W),
      (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) (p q : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
        (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj U),
        (((chi.app (P, Q) ≫ CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
          (completionBoundary l E W P Q) ≫
          Pi.π (fun n ↦ (integralOperationsTensorLevel l E W n).obj (P, Q)) n).f
            (p + q)).val.app U)
          (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology W)
            (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W) P Q p q (p + q) rfl U x y) =
        integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E W n P Q p q U
          (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E W n (P.X p) U 1 x)
          (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E W n (Q.X q) U 1 y)) ∧
      (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) (i j : ℤ)
        (h : i + -1 = j),
        (chi.app (P, Q)).f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
          (completionBoundary l E W P Q)).v i j h = 0) ∧
      ∃ tau : T ⟶ integralCompletedTensor l E W,
        (∀ (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory),
          e.hom.app (P, Q) ≫ tau.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj,
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj) ≫
            (integralCompletedTensorComparison l E W).hom.app (P, Q) =
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (chi.app (P.obj, Q.obj))) ∧
        ∀ M N : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E W),
          sfIntegralConstructible l E W M → sfIntegralConstructible l E W N →
          IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted l E W (T.obj (M, N)) ∧ IsIso (tau.app (M, N))
